description_html:
This is our full interview with Goldman Sachs Chairman & CEO David Solomon.

We discuss how Goldman Sachs is evolving its business, the growing threat of cyberattacks and how AI is changing cybersecurity, the outlook for IPOs and private markets, NVIDIA's future without Jensen Huang, the role of capital in America's reindustrialization, where the biggest opportunities in AI will emerge, and his reaction to Jensen's latest statement about potentially returning as CEO.
